_doc: PIPELINE-SHADER-MAP — declared pipeline -> shader-file grouping for check-vulkan-bindings.py per-pipeline binding classification (slice BINDING-CHECKER-PER-PIPELINE-CLASSIFIER-1).
_why: A GL binding-base slot number is only semantic INSIDE one pipeline's descriptor-set layout. The binding-slot-occupancy census aggregates physical-slot reuse across the WHOLE shader corpus, so it flags benign disjoint-pipeline shares (e.g. SurfaceVertexBuf@20 in terrain-surface vs LightsData@20 in the lit pipelines) as if they were collisions. This manifest declares which shader files compose each pipeline so the checker can ask the ONLY question Vulkan cares about: do two DISTINCT resources share a (set,binding) inside the SAME pipeline's layout?
_how_built: Authored (declared manifest, not inferred). Stage members = the directly-authored .vert/.frag/.tesc/.tese/.comp files that link into one program, taken from the shader-file list in binding-slot-occupancy.json and the pipeline enumeration in docs/render-backend-seams/slot-14-20-split-plan.md (commit 805c3265). 'includes' lists the binding-bearing .hglsl files each pipeline pulls (verified with grep '#include' on each stage file: mech/static_prop/building_pbr/gos_tex_vertex_lighted include lighting.hglsl; gos_terrain_surface.vert does NOT). A role declared in an include belongs to every pipeline that includes that file; an include is NOT itself a pipeline. C++ glBindBufferBase(literal) sites carry no GLSL role and are ignored for resource-distinctness.
_model: For each physical slot, group its GLSL role-declarations by owning pipeline. A role declared in a stage file belongs to that file's pipeline(s); a role declared in an include belongs to every pipeline listing that include. If ONE pipeline ends up owning >1 DISTINCT role on a slot -> ERROR (real Vulkan (set,binding) collision). If the distinct roles live in DIFFERENT pipelines -> disjoint share: OK if allowlisted benign, else WARN.
_unmodeled_note: view_uniforms.hglsl declares ViewUniformsBlock (UBO:3) and is included broadly; it is single-occupant on its slot so it needs no pipeline attribution for collision purposes. scene.hglsl SceneData (UBO:1) shares a slot with mesh_data (building_pbr.vert / gos_tex_vertex_lighted.vert) — attributed via the 'includes' entries above. Any shader file appearing in binding-slot-occupancy.json but NOT covered by a pipeline here is reported by the checker as 'unmodeled' and its shares fall through to WARN, never silently OK.
